Desktop builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

- **macOS:** download the universal `.dmg` for Apple Silicon or Intel. macOS 15
  or later is required. This preview was tested on Apple Silicon with macOS 27;
  macOS 15 and Intel hardware have not been tested. The app is not signed with
  a Developer ID or notarized. If macOS blocks it, see Apple's instructions for
  [opening an app from an unidentified developer](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445).
- **Windows:** download the `.exe` and run it. The installer is unsigned, so
  Windows SmartScreen may warn; choose “More info” and then “Run anyway”.
- **Linux:** use the `.AppImage` (make it executable first), `.deb` for
  Debian/Ubuntu, or `.rpm` for Fedora/RHEL.
